name: Skitgubbe
description: Skitgubbe (Swedish: 'Shit Old Man', also known simply as 'Skit' or 'Mattis') is a traditional Swedish card game for 3 players. It is divided into two distinct phases: Phase 1 (Trick-Taking/Collection) where players try to gather good cards, and Phase 2 (Shedding/Battle) where the goal is to get rid of all cards. The loser is the last player holding cards and is declared the 'Skitgubbe'.

content.text: Skitgubbe (Swedish: 'Shit Old Man', also known simply as 'Skit' or 'Mattis') is a traditional Swedish card game for 3 players. It is divided into two distinct phases: Phase 1 (Trick-Taking/Collection) where players try to gather good cards, and Phase 2 (Shedding/Battle) where the goal is to get rid of all cards. The loser is the last player holding cards and is declared the 'Skitgubbe'.
Dates back to the 19th century in rural Sweden. Related to Finnish 'Paskahousu' (Shit Pants).
Two to four players; best for three.
Deal three cards to each player clockwise, starting with forehand. Place the remainder face down as the stock (talon).

items.text: All play to each trick (phase 1): In phase 1 all players play to each trick; highest rank wins; ties resolved by replay. Can use sluffing. Often played 2–6 players.
Mas with turned up trump: Trump turned up after deal; phase 1 beat by higher led suit or trump. Player with three trumps may store them and draw three new; two of trumps may exchange for turnup.
